content:
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

# 13 release files
$files = @(
  "index.html", "style.css", "config.js", "three.min.js",
  "map.js", "player.js", "enemy.js", "textures.js",
  "weapon.js", "hud.js", "audio.js", "pickup.js", "main.js"
)

# backup old zip
if (Test-Path "cs1.5-minitool.zip") {
  Move-Item "cs1.5-minitool.zip" "cs1.5-minitool.backup-20260817.zip" -Force
}

# clean staging
if (Test-Path "_release") { Remove-Item "_release" -Recurse -Force }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path "_release" | Out-Null

# copy
foreach ($f in $files) {
  Copy-Item $f (Join-Path "_release" $f)
}

$count = (Get-ChildItem "_release" -File).Count
Write-Output "copied=$count"

# zip (index.html at root)
Push-Location "_release"
Compress-Archive -Path * -DestinationPath "..\cs1.5-minitool.zip" -Force
Pop-Location

$size = (Get-Item "cs1.5-minitool.zip").Length
Write-Output "zip_size=$size"
